page_title: NAN 3-0 MNT | Nantes v Montpellier 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
88' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes) replacing Pedro Chirivella.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) will replace Moses Simon.
85' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Becir Omeragic (Montpellier). Nantes have a free kick.
81' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) and blew his whistle. Nantes win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
79' 3 - 0 Goal! Matthis Abline (Nantes) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the top left corner.
75' Moses Simon (Nantes) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
73' Substitution. Francis Coquelin did his best and is replaced by Johann Lepenant (Nantes).
72' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Sorba Thomas is replaced by Fabien Centonze (Nantes).
72' Substitution. Nathan Zeze (Nantes) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolas Pallois walks off.
71' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) sees a yellow card from Clement Turpin after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
69' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
66' The game is interrupted now, Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' The resulting corner from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
62' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
57' The foul by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Clement Turpin.
57' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Montpellier.
56' The corner from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is cleared away by the defence.
53' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Sorba Thomas (Nantes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

51' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Montpellier win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
49' Today's referee Clement Turpin rightly decides to book Theo Chennahi (Montpellier) for his harsh tackle.
46' Here comes a substitution. Teji Savanier is given a rest as he is replaced by Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier).
46' Zoumana Camara has made a change at the break. Modibo Sagnan has come on in place of Yael Mouanga (Montpellier).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
40' Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
40' Anthony Lopes (Nantes) is able to continue to play.
38' Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Anthony Lopes (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Louis Leroux (Nantes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Montpellier will take a free kick.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
34' Theo Chennahi (Montpellier) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
32' Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

31' 2 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Francis Coquelin (Nantes) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Dimitry Bertaud. 2:0.
31' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
30' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

30' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dimitry Bertaud intercepts the ball.
25' Enzo Tchato is being substituted because of an injury. Zoumana Camara sends Wilfried Ndollo Bille (Montpellier) on the pitch.

23' Clement Turpin blows for a foul after Matthis Abline (Nantes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Montpellier, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

23' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) leaps to meet an excellent cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends in a fantastic header towards the roof of the net. The opponent’s defence, however, master the situation well and keeps the ball out.
22' The referee awards a corner and Sorba Thomas (Nantes) goes over to take it.
22' A long ball forward to Moses Simon (Nantes) is intercepted.
18' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Moses Simon (Nantes) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Dimitry Bertaud no chance!
18' Moses Simon (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
17' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Nantes!

17' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nantes players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Clement Turpin interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
16' Moses Simon (Nantes) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
13' Moses Simon (Nantes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
11' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
10' Matthis Abline (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Nantes have a corner.
8' It seemed like Sorba Thomas (Nantes) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
7' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
4' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nantes will kick the game off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
